tagline: A real-time talking 3D anime companion for the web, built in the open.
focus: Motion now follows conversational-behaviour research: nods on stressed syllables, eye contact with short looks away, natural blink rates, moods that flash and fade. A character switcher lets the local build swap models.

milestones.name: Research: open-source base (verdict: thin app on three-vrm)
Research: voice, LLM and speech-to-text stack
Avatar on screen: blinking, idle motion, expressions
Voice loop: mic in, streamed reply, lip sync, interruptions
Hosting for the API side + custom domain
